learning_outcomes.text: Solve first order and second order ordinary and partial differential equations for engineering problems.
Solve simultaneous homogeneous ordinary differential equations
Implement numerical methods to obtain solutions for mathematical problems.
Apply mathematical software in the solution to problems involving topics on the syllabus.

syllabus_topics: The use of a computer algebra system (for example MATLAB or similar)
Use of the software applied to the syllabus items below
The solution of first order Ordinary Differential Equations (ODE) by the integrating factor method
The solution of second order ODE's by the method of undetermined coefficients
Application to single degree of freedom oscillating systems
Functions of several variables
Partial differentiation with application to optimisation and error estimation
Eigenvalues and eigenvectors
Manual calculation for low order matrices
Use of software for matrices of larger order
Solution of two first and second order, homogeneous simultaneous ODE's with constant coefficients
Application to normal modes for a two degree of freedom system
Laplace transforms concepts
Use of tables for Laplace transforms
The inverse Laplace transform
Application of Laplace transforms to the solution of ODE's
Transfer functions and stability
Periodic functions
Fourier series for functions of any period
Harmonics
Numerical solution of ODE's
Euler's method and application of software
Introduction to programming in MATLAB or similar symbolic mathematical software
Use numerical methods to solve engineering problems using appropriate software (e.g. MATLAB)
